title: H0353 (2023 Regular): Conditions of Pretrial release

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2023-01-23; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2023/353/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2657575))

operative_text: Section 1 (s. 903.047, F.S.): 903.047 Conditions of pretrial release.— (3) If a court orders a defendant to surrender his or her firearms or ammunition or prohibits a defendant's possession of firearms or ammunition as a condition of pretrial release, it is a violation of this section for the defendant to have in his or her care, custody, possession, or control a firearm or any ammunition.
